slip_it_in.text: I'm thinking about starting a 'competitive llama grooming' business.

Have you noticed how much the clouds look like mashed potatoes?

convince_me.text: Convince someone that Idaho is actually the only state that doesn't exist on European maps.
Get someone to agree to a pinky-swear that they will only walk backward for the next 2 minutes.
